content: It has become a common culture to use #tags across social media. So we have replaced multiple #tags with a single #tag. Mostly @ symbol id used to mention person or entities in a tweet. So we replace multiple @symbols with a single @-mention. Some tweets may contain the link to a website or some other urls. So we replace all of these with a single keyword URLS.
